card.name: Linking words after abstract nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "to" or "the" right after an abstract noun or verb like education, maintenance, source, stages or learning. Seen in prose about reading, education, ethics and physiology.

modes.label: "of" after process nouns
modes.description: The word "of" follows a noun such as maintenance, education, source or stages, before the thing it relates to.
